name: scriptflow-studio
description: ScriptFlow Studio is a browser-local, no-cost MVP for planning AI-assisted long-form videos. It creates a script, breaks it into visual beats, matches media, previews a storyboard with browser TTS, and exports files for a local or cloud renderer.
